We advocate increasing research activity in Green AI—AI research that is more environmentally friendly and inclusive. We emphasize that Red AI research has been yielding valuable contributions to the field of AI, but it’s been overly dominant. We want to shift the balance towards the Green AI option—to ensure that any inspired undergraduate with a laptop has the opportunity to write high-quality papers that could be accepted at premier research conferences.![img-0.jpeg](img-0.jpeg)
